FIELD MANUAL / V1

Claim it. Challenge it. Lock it.

01

Arrive outdoors

Leave transit and reach a public outdoor location inside the territory. The first team there records its name in Claimed by.

02

One challenge at a time

Confirm your arrival before revealing a card. Record the reveal order and Active status in your team tab. Finish or abandon your current challenge before opening another.

03

Secure the territory

Complete the challenge and record your team in Locked by. This overrides the initial claim, including when stealing an opponent's unlocked territory.

04

Make your decision

Retry only if the card allows it and you have not opened another challenge. Once you move on, that challenge cannot be retried. Locked territories cannot be stolen.

Honor system: the sheet is the shared record. Device memory is optional and does not enforce team rules. Challenge files are discoverable in this static site's source.
